t2i_prompt: Flat desktop UI mockup with a mobile version beside it on a warm limestone background, no device frame, no people. A deep navy blueprint panel shows <CONTENT> as numbered steps descending left to right like a staircase, joined by a single steel-blue pipe that zigzags down through elbow fittings from one step to the next. Each step is framed by corner brackets, with a large light title, one sentence and a steel-blue label line. Dot grid ground, faint crosshairs, tiny drawing reference tags, generous negative space; on mobile the pipe becomes a straight vertical rail.
signature_idea: The project timeline is a pipe: water drops step by step down a staircase of stages.
strengths: the pipe metaphor is native to a water systems maker and doubles as a scroll-progress device
very close to brand palette and calm spacing
weaknesses: pipe is decorative weight that may compete with text
staircase needs a wide viewport and wastes space bottom-left
brand_fit_why: Navy panel, limestone, one steel-blue accent, light large titles, square corner brackets and space used as material: almost exactly the brand book.
